stories.title: NCTV en AIVD waarschuwen voor ‘bewuste normalisering’ van rechts-extremisme, ook bij politieke partijen

en.title: NCTV and AIVD warn of 'deliberate normalization' of right-wing extremism, also among political parties
en.summary: Dutch intelligence and counterterrorism agencies warn that right-wing extremists are attempting to normalize their ideology online, at demonstrations, and within political parties by presenting softer versions of their views to appear more acceptable.

stories.title: 12 jaar cel geëist tegen ambtenaar voor corruptie en link met zwaar geweld

en.title: 12 years prison demanded against official for corruption and link with serious violence
en.summary: An Amsterdam municipal official faces charges of corruption and aiding serious violent incidents after allegedly leaking personal data 600 times in nine months. Prosecutors seek 12 years imprisonment for the 48-year-old and 10 years each for two information brokers involved.

stories.title: AIVD en NCTV waarschuwen voor normalisering extreemrechtse denkbeelden

en.title: AIVD and NCTV warn of normalization of far-right ideology
en.summary: Intelligence agencies report that right-wing extremists are normalizing their ideas through online channels, politics, media, and demonstrations by using softer language and selective terminology to make their views more widely acceptable.

stories.title: Van Weel oneens met kritiek Rekenkamer over informeren, Kamer wil debat

en.title: Van Weel disagrees with audit office criticism over informing parliament; chamber wants debate
en.summary: Justice Minister David van Weel disputes the audit office's finding that he misled parliament about police statistics regarding thousands of unprocessed criminal reports.

stories.title: Justitie eist twaalf jaar cel tegen ambtenaar in corruptiezaak die ‘zijn weerga niet kent’

en.title: Justice demands twelve years prison against official in corruption case that 'has no equal'
en.summary: Prosecutors are seeking a twelve-year prison sentence against a government official in a corruption case described as unprecedented in scope.

stories.title: AIVD en NCTV waarschuwen voor rechts-extremisme: 'Proberen politiek te beïnvloeden'

en.title: AIVD and NCTV warn of right-wing extremism: 'Attempting to influence politics'
en.summary: Dutch intelligence and counterterrorism agencies warn that right-wing extremists are presenting softer versions of their ideology to make their views acceptable to wider audiences.

stories.title: Mensje van Keulen schrijft Boekenweekgeschenk met thema 'Kijk ons nou'

en.title: Mensje van Keulen writes Book Week gift with theme 'Look at us now'
en.summary: Author Mensje van Keulen will write the 2027 Book Week gift distributed in Dutch bookstores in March, recognized as a tribute to her influential literary career.

stories.title: Mensje van Keulen schrijft Boekenweekgeschenk voor 2027, NRC-columnist Japke-d. Bouma schrijft het essay

en.title: Mensje van Keulen writes Book Week gift for 2027, NRC columnist Japke-d. Bouma writes the essay
en.summary: Mensje van Keulen is writing the 2027 Book Week gift fifty-five years after her debut, with columnist Japke-d. Bouma contributing the accompanying essay on human behavior.

stories.title: De Boekenweek kon niet meer om Mensje van Keulen heen: volgend jaar schrijft zij het geschenk

en.title: De Boekenweek could not avoid Mensje van Keulen: next year she will write the gift
en.summary: Mensje van Keulen has been selected to write the gift book for next year's Dutch Book Week, a prestigious annual cultural honor.

stories.title: Tot twaalf jaar cel geëist in grootste corruptiezaak met grof geweld tot gevolg

en.title: Up to twelve years imprisonment demanded in largest corruption case with serious violence as consequence
en.summary: Prosecutors have sought sentences of up to twelve years in a major corruption case involving an Amsterdam municipal official whose illegal information access led to 95 violent incidents within one year.

stories.title: Kamer wil debat en opheldering Van Weel over onjuiste informatie aangiftes

en.title: Chamber wants debate and clarification from Van Weel over incorrect information on complaints
en.summary: Parliament seeks urgent discussions with Justice Minister Van Weel regarding inaccurate statements he provided to the Court of Audit about thousands of unprocessed serious crime reports in 2024.

stories.title: Algemene Rekenkamer: Van Weel zette Tweede Kamer op ‘verkeerde been’ over 10.000 onbehandelde aangiften

en.title: General Audit Office: Van Weel misled Second Chamber over 10,000 unprocessed complaints
en.summary: The Court of Audit contradicts the Justice Minister's claim that most unprocessed criminal complaints lacked sufficient grounds for investigation, stating his characterization was incorrect.
